# Orient Global Flagship - Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria

> Orient Global Flagship is a premier luxury hospitality, fine dining, and multi-division destination located at Amada Plaza, Rayfield, Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria.

## Core Information
- **Location:** Amada Plaza, Rayfield, Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria
- **Hours:** Open Daily, 8:00 AM - 11:00 PM (WAT)
- **Cuisine:** Nigerian Heritage Fine Dining, Woodfire Charcoal Grills, Artisanal French & Sourdough Pastries, Continental Specialities
- **Reservations & Inquiries:** Concierge available via live AI chat (AURA) on https://orientglobalflagship.com
- **Services:** Fine Dining, Table Reservations, Delivery & Takeaway, Private VIP Sommelier Cellar, B2B Sourcing, Gaming Arena

## Divisions
1. **Orient Fine Dining Restaurant:** Heritage Nigerian gastronomy, smoky party jollof, tender goat meat asun, woodfire catfish, rich traditional soups (Egusi, Efo Riro, Seafood Okra, Ogbono), and artisanal swallows (Pounded Yam, Amala).
2. **Orient Artisanal Bakery:** Wild 48h sourdough boule, Parisian butter croissants, pain au chocolat, berry tarts, bagels, and bespoke confectionery.
3. **Orient Supermarket:** Highland organic produce, imported goods, pantry staples, and farm-fresh dairy.
4. **Orient Gaming & Esports Arena:** High-performance simulation rigs, VR battle stations, competitive leagues, and gaming lounge.
5. **Orient Atmospheric Water & Wellness:** 7-stage molecular spring water purification (75cl, 50cl, and 19L dispenser refills).
6. **Orient Luxury Lounge & VIP Cellar:** Vintage wine reserves, sommelier tastings, botanical cocktails, and executive networking.
